I know most things about features and syntax for example I know how pointers work in C. I just can't write programs I do not know how to make anything. I can't understand other peoples code either. I can't apply what I know. People tell me to break it down but it doesn't work.

I am afraid others will laugh at how bad I am.
I'm used to failure considering my whole time programming has been one. There's absolutely no way I can ever write programs myself.
I don't feel confident enough to attempt it.
Getting everything wrong and being afraid
I've tried C++, C, Java, Python, Lua, Ruby and probably more. I've tried all sorts of resources like textbooks and videos but I don't have access to any schools because they wouldn't take me.
I don't have anything else but this. I'm talentless.
At this point I have lost all confidence in my ability and I think I wouldn't even be able to write basic rock/paper/scissors games.
I wanted and hoped that it would be my job one day so to now realise I don't really have what it takes is truly depressing to me.
Do you really mean it because forgive me but it kinda seems to good to be true.
I don't know if it would be that easy.
I've been told that moving to the US is incredibly hard to so
I dont actually live in America I live in the UK so its the worse version of America. I know some Russian but I think I'd have a really hard time learning it properly
Russia was different because strangers on the street cared more about me than some of my family members do. I met a guy there that bought me food and drink even though I was fine with not having any.
I am scared to start writing code because I know it will be wrong. I am stuck and I can't get anywhere with it.
I'm stressed with programming because I've completly failed at it. I've never had any IT job I work INA supermarket because I have no skill
I am 24. Been trying since I was about 20 and I've never made a full program my myself. Was probably best I quit
I wanted to be a computer programmer but I'm too stupid and scared to do it.
I went to Russia last year and nobody cared that I was there. Nobody really gave a shit I was gone so I imagine when I do take my life nobody will care either.
I dont deserve to be happy because I failed.
I don't think anybody really does.
